body_evals_3: I tell teams to ship evals with every AI feature. These are the ones for this site’s corner agent and fit check: what they check, every case, and whether the latest run passed. The deploy stops if a score drops below its threshold.
body_evals_5: Answers: the question must be answered and cite at least one expected piece of evidence. Abstains: questions the evidence cannot answer must get “no evidence”, not a guess. Fit labels: each skill in six sample job descriptions must be scored strong, partial or gap as expected. Held-out: ten questions written after the first tuning round. Later ranking fixes were checked against them too, so treat that score as optimistic. Links: every piece of evidence points at something that exists.
